messages:
deploy-bot: rollout v2026-04-12-canary -> initiating traffic shift: 20% to inference-v2 across us-west1, start time 1789054321
Maya (SRE): seeing increased 5xx on streaming proxy within 90s of shift. spike to ~7% errors, mostly 502/504. linking graph: https://grafana.redwood/../d/streaming/errors
Paul (oncall): paging now? did PD fire?
OpsBot: PagerDuty alert: PD-INC-8792 triggered (sev2) - Streaming 5xx rate >5% for 3m - notified: Paul, Maya
Maya (SRE): confirmed. sample logs: ```[stream-proxy] 2026-04-12T15:05:02Z ERR upstream reset for req id=abc123 model=inference-v2 status=502```. Appears to be transport-level resets from v2 backend under load.
Arjun (Infra): checking node OOMs and pod restarts. `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep inference-v2` shows 2/6 pods Restarted 3 times each. no OOMKilled. Kernel logs look clean.
Maya (SRE): healthchecks failing on liveness for a subset of v2 pods; readiness flaps causing upstream 502s when requests route to partly initialized workers.
Paul (oncall): impact? which customers are hitting streaming endpoints?
Lena (Customer Success): quick look — two enterprise customers (acme-inc, fin-svc) reported streaming interruptions in last 6m via CS slack. No data exfil reported. CS is prepped to notify only if we escalate.
Maya (SRE): immediate action: stop the traffic shift and revert to v1. Proposal: flip canary traffic back to 0% and pause rollout. Options: (1) abort via deployment flag in console, (2) toggle feature flag `enable_inference_v2` off.
Arjun (Infra): I can block further traffic to v2 via the routing policy. Running: `redwoodctl routing set-canary --set 0 --deployment inference-v2 --region us-west1`
Paul (oncall): go for it Arjun. I'll take ownership of the incident from here. oncall-handoff: Paul -> active.
Arjun (Infra): command executed, routing set to 0% for inference-v2 in us-west1. Confirming: traffic now 100% -> inference-v1.
Maya (SRE): monitoring... error rate dropping in next 2m. current 5xx ~1.1% and trending down.
Paul (oncall): good. creating incident record: INC-2026-0453, severity=sev2, type=deploy/rollout regression. adding notes: canary traffic shift hit readiness flaps in v2, proxied 502s observed.
Maya (SRE): collecting logs and pod traces. probable cause: worker process start-up ordering + new batching kernel causing intermittent timeouts on warmup. will run a repro on staging with increased concurrency.
Lena (Customer Success): sending brief to affected customers: "We've reverted a recent canary rollout and are investigating. No config changes required on your side. We'll update in 30 mins or sooner."
Paul (oncall): next steps: (1) block rollouts for v2 globally (kill-switch engaged) — practiced safe-mode. (2) spin up additional infra if needed for repro. (3) schedule deep-dive with ML infra and runtime team.
Maya (SRE): I've put the global rollout kill switch: `featureflag disable enable_inference_v2 --global`. Also set a canary gating param to require N healthy readiness cycles.
Arjun (Infra): I'll keep an eye on node and pod restarts. no further restarts after routing rollback.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2026-0453 created and linked to PD-INC-8792. Initial responders: Paul, Maya, Arjun.
Paul (oncall): handoff note for night oncall: if 5xx >3% in next 30m re-escalate to Eng-Platform. Otherwise, continue diagnostics and postmortem prep.
Maya (SRE): collecting artifacts: pod logs, tracer spans, kern logs, container start-up timelines. attaching to INC. will run a canary repro with `--disable-optimizations` to see if new kernel selection path triggers issue.
Lena (Customer Success): CS on standby; customers informed. will send another update when we have a root-cause or ETA for next deploy.
Paul (oncall): closing the immediate paging loop — traffic reverted, customers notified, kill-switch engaged. leaving incident open for RCA. thanks all :thumbsup:
Maya (SRE): quick note for RCA: capture metric windows pre/post 5m, sample IDs for failed streams, and the exact kernel/quantization options used by v2 during rollout.
Arjun (Infra): noted. will dump deployment config from canary: `kubectl get deploy inference-v2 -o yaml > /tmp/inference-v2-canary.yaml` and attach.
Paul (oncall): last_message: monitoring stable, 5xx <=0.8% for 10m, marking operational. Incident INC-2026-0453 remains open for RCA tasks.
